name: get_weather
description: Get the current weather and wind for a place (meteo, vento, che tempo fa).

name: start_timer_minutes
description: Start a countdown timer of a number of minutes (timer di N minuti, mezz'ora, un'ora).

name: start_timer_seconds
description: Start a countdown timer of a number of seconds (timer di N secondi).

name: set_alarm
description: Set an alarm clock (sveglia, svegliami) at a given time of day.

time.description: Time of day in 24 hour HH:MM format, e.g. 07:30

name: open_home
description: Open the home page with the clock (apri la home, orologio, che ore sono).

name: open_weather
description: Open the weather page (apri il meteo, mostra il meteo, previsioni).

name: open_timer
description: Open the timer page (apri il timer, mostra il timer).

name: open_alarm
description: Open the alarm page (apri la sveglia, mostra le sveglie).

name: open_system
description: Open the system page with cpu, memory and disk (apri sistema, stato del sistema, mostra la cpu).

name: open_settings
description: Open the settings page (apri le impostazioni, luminosità, calibra).

name: lights_on
description: Turn ON the lights of a room (accendi, accendere, attiva, luce accesa).

room.description: Room name as said, e.g. soggiorno, terrazza, soppalco, corridoio; use 'tutte' for all the lights

name: lights_off
description: Turn OFF the lights of a room (spegni, spegnere, disattiva, luce spenta, buio).

room.description: Room name as said, e.g. soggiorno, terrazza, soppalco, corridoio; use 'tutte' for all the lights

name: set_brightness
description: Change the BRIGHTNESS level of the lights of a room to a percentage (luminosità, intensità, al 50%, al 30 per cento, a 80, dimmer, abbassa, alza).

room.description: Room name as said, e.g. soggiorno, terrazza, soppalco, corridoio; use 'tutte' for all the lights
